arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. As the machine came with the flat, we need to check with the landlord first, including that a replacement would stay your property and go with you when you leave. We've asked them and will update you as soon as we hear. This is a routine job, so our target is to get it sorted within 14 days. Please don't dispose of the old machine yet. If you can, send a photo of it and any error code on the display.

options: Agree: tenant replaces at own cost, keeps it as their property and takes it when they leave (old unit removed/disposed of)

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. As the machine came with the flat, we need to check with the landlord first, including that a replacement would stay your property and go with you when you leave. We've asked them and will update you as soon as we hear. This is a routine job, so our target is to get it sorted within 14 days. Please don't dispose of the old machine yet. If you can, send a photo of it and any error code on the display.
